The '''Drexel Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Khuiumin sector/Legends|Khuiumin sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drexel II]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the Drexel Minor system was created because the [[Drexel system/Legends|Drexel system]] from [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel Star Wars]] has only one planet, [[Drexel/Legends|Drexel]], and can't also contain [[Drexel II]].<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30387023|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2009-08-28|time=11:05 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20180225165344/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-109}}</ref>
